data.title: Identifier Check
data.solution:
import re

IDENTIFIER_PATTERN = re.compile(r"[a-z](?:[a-z0-9_-]*[a-z0-9])?")

n = int(input())
for _ in range(n):
    s = input()
    print("VALID" if IDENTIFIER_PATTERN.fullmatch(s) else "INVALID")

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

Given n strings, determine whether each string s is a valid identifier in a fictional language.

A valid identifier contains only lowercase letters (a-z), digits (0-9), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a lowercase letter and end with a lowercase letter or a digit.
Input
Line 1: An integer n, the number of strings.
Next n lines: One string s per line.
Output
n lines: For each string s, in input order, print VALID if it is a valid identifier, otherwise print INVALID.
Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 20
1 ≤ length of s ≤ 100
Each s contains only printable ASCII characters (codes 32 to 126).
Example
Input
4
name
user_42
user-id
42user
Output
VALID
VALID
VALID
INVALID
